title: The GAMMALN held-out gates were captured through GAMMALN.PRECISE, not GAMMALN
status_plain: Two held-out gates exist for the published GAMMALN kernel: held2, 400 rows from the round-3 sweep, and held-, 1,200 rows from the round-2 golden-ratio sweep. Both were held out from the COEFFICIENT FITS, not from the structural identification -- the 0.7 threshold, the 8.0 seam and the Stirling form were pinned on the batteries surrounding these rows. The arguments in both gates are GAMMALN.PRECISE captures, so the inheritance runs from .PRECISE to GAMMALN and not the other way. OxFunc contradicts itself on the held2 number: the campaign resume publishes 314/400 under "Corpus scores after all landings" while the summary table in the same file, and the catalogue row, still print 79.0% (316/400) from the superseded first landing. The weaker figure, 314/400, is published here.

retractions.superseded_by: All 400 held2 arguments appear in the build-20131 GAMMALN.PRECISE oracle shard and zero of them in the GAMMALN shard; conversely all 1,600 b32 arguments are GAMMALN captures and appear in zero .PRECISE rows. The direction of inheritance was inverted.

retractions.superseded_by: GAMMALN x>=11 IS the plain-double Cephes Stirling tail + UCRT-class log; then superseded again by round 3, which found no Stirling switch at 12 at all.

open_question: B1 [0.7,1.5) and B2 [1.5,4) exact coefficients remain open, and the internal-CRT-log +-1 class accounts for 7 of the 10 residuals at x >= 8.
reader_warning: The 400-row and 1,200-row gates were held out from the COEFFICIENT FIT only. The structural identification -- thresholds, seam, band skeleton, Stirling form -- was pinned on the batteries that surround these rows, so this is not a held-out test of the identification. And the two OxFunc figures for the same gate (314 and 316) are both live in the tree.
